summary: Dynatrace, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 25, 2026, reporting that on September 24, 2026 its subsidiaries Dynatrace LLC (borrower) and Dynatrace Intermediate LLC (holdings) entered a $500 million senior secured revolving Credit Agreement with Bank of America as administrative agent. Borrowings may be in USD, EUR, GBP and CAD, capped at $100 million non-USD, priced off Term SOFR, EURIBOR, CORRA, SONIA or base rate plus leverage- or ratings-based margins. This is a routine credit-facility current report, not a special situation.
